svg.title: Find the perfect icon. — Callout Studio
svg.desc: Pick an icon and Manage icon libraries, with all nine icon libraries available and the requested order. Purple promotional frame with a simplified Obsidian workspace. Desktop store artwork, 1200 by 800 pixels.

text.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
